district_name: Washington Central Unified Union School District

jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(J) inventory: Washington Central Unified Union School District, a unified union district that is its own supervisory district (member towns: Berlin, Calais, East Montpelier, Middlesex, Worcester). Operates PK-12.

board.org_name: Washington Central Unified Union School Board
board.post_note: WCUUSD: fifteen directors, residency allocated three per member town (Berlin, Calais, East Montpelier, Middlesex, Worcester), all voted on by the entire district electorate with comingled ballots (modified at-large, Articles Arts. 10-11).

sources.note: WCUUSD Board Members page (official, fetched 2026-10-22; post-March 2026 state): all 15 members with towns and published term ends -- Nichols-Fleming (Berlin) 2029, Boye (Berlin) 2028 (two years of a 3-year term), Lindig (Berlin) 2027 (one year of a 3-year term), Brown (Calais) 2027, Ksepka (Calais) 2028, Keeney (Calais) 2029, Sullivan (East Montpelier) 2027, Diaz Smith (East Montpelier) 2029, Buchanan (East Montpelier) NO term published, Whelley (Middlesex) 2027, Stanley (Middlesex) 2028, McVeigh (Middlesex) 2029, Eckart (Worcester) 2027 (two years of a 3-year term), Hewitt (Worcester) 2028, McMahon (Worcester) 2029. The Articles of Agreement (with voter-approved amendments), Art. 11: 15 members, 3 per town; Art. 10(A)/11: seats allocated per town but "voted on by the entire electorate" with comingled votes -- modified at-large (the articles' "Hybrid Model"). The district's March 12, 2026 committee-assignments memo corroborates 13 of the 15 at the reorganization. FLAG (Buchanan): no term and no seating document published for her (she is absent from the March 2026 memo; Dave Lowther appears there but not on the current page -- an undocumented mid-year change; Lowther's departure is likewise undocumented and no record is minted for him). Resolving document: the WCUUSD March 3, 2026 annual meeting warning + certified results. Boye/Lindig/Eckart hold remainder seats the district regularly warns for election -- minted ELECTED.
